_about: What each role may do out of the box, as agreed with the client (written down in PermissionRegistry::ROLE_DEFAULTS). A user: sees and exports the business, changes nothing. A manager: runs the day-to-day (creates, edits, settles, exports) but deletes nothing, does not mark movements reviewed (that locks them; it is the company's own sign-off), and does not touch users, roles, companies or an owner's private accounts. A company admin: everything in the company, including deleting, reviewing and its users and roles — but not other companies or the platform. A super admin: everything. The lines below are examples worked out from those sentences, not copied from the code.
